column1: # p811 2026-11-13 — a channel that resolves a GitHub account's DECLARED location without the blocked users/{login} endpoint.
# CHANNEL: gh api -X GET search/repositories ... is for repos; for accounts: gh api -X GET search/users -f q='user:LOGIN location:"PLACE"'
# READING: total_count=1 CONFIRMS the declared location contains PLACE. A 0 is AMBIGUOUS three ways:
#   (a) a different location, (b) an empty location field, (c) an UNQUOTED multi-word place.
# DEFECT FOUND: 'location:Hong Kong' (unquoted) parses as location:Hong + free-text 'Kong' and returns 0
#   for an account whose location IS Hong Kong. The same query quoted returns 1. The failure is SILENT.
# NOT RUN AT SCALE, DELIBERATELY: sweeping ~45 individual maintainers' declared locations is person-level
#   data collection about private individuals for a commercial file. Declined. Author origin therefore stays
#   unresolved in this base BY CHOICE. No later pass should "fix" this by running the sweep.
# WHAT WAS USED INSTEAD: T32 — place a row by the region in which the SYSTEM IT INTEGRATES WITH is operated,
#   read from the repository's own description.
